Under [[Registrar una factura de proveedor]], choose the order or the internal purchase, type number, amount, dates and how it arrived, and click [[Registrar]].
Read the result: they match, invoiced above the order, invoiced more than received or service not accepted.
For a service: [[Aceptar el servicio]]. For a justified difference: [[Aceptar la diferencia]] with the reason.
If the invoice is not for a customer order: [[Aprobar el pago]] and then [[Registrar el pago]] with the bank reference.
adm-pagar.expect: The same invoice number from the same supplier is not recorded twice. Whoever recorded the invoice cannot approve its payment. Approving is not paying. Invoices of an order are paid from the order, with its milestones.

adm-presupuesto.why: What was assigned, committed, spent, what is left and what its owner expects at the end.
steps: Management or Finance: under “ASSIGN A BUDGET”, type name, owner, dates and amount, and click [[Asignar]].
Open «De dónde salen las cifras» to see each purchase and each trip that uses it.
The owner: open “Update the forecast” and type the expected total and what it is based on.
adm-presupuesto.expect: An approved purchase uses the budget even if it has not been paid. What is requested and not approved is shown apart and does not use it. Internal purchases and trips appear by themselves.

adm-compras-internas.why: What the company buys for itself: internal use, assets and investments. First the need; then the budget and who authorizes.
steps: Under [[Pedir una compra interna]], type what is bought, what it is needed for, the amount and the budget, and click [[Pedir]].
Whoever decides opens it from “AWAITING YOUR DECISION” and uses [[Aprobar]], [[Devolver con una pregunta]] or [[No aprobar]].
When it is bought: [[Ya se compró]]. If it is an asset, register it from the link.
adm-compras-internas.expect: Nobody decides their own purchase. Without a budget, or above what is left of it, it is an exception: Management decides and the reason is required. Marking it bought moves it from committed to spent.

adm-activos.why: What the company owns, who is in charge of it and what it needs soon: insurance, maintenance, warranty.
steps: Under [[Registrar un activo]], type name, type, which company it is registered to and its dates, and click [[Registrar]].
Open the asset and, under “HAND OVER, MOVE OR RETURN”, choose who it is handed to.
Whoever is in charge of it records maintenance and mileage under “RECORD SOMETHING THAT HAPPENED”.
Read the “HISTORY”.
adm-activos.expect: The history is not edited or deleted. Mileage cannot go down. Each person sees the assets in their charge; Administration sees them all.

adm-obligaciones.why: With whom, what for, until when, when notice must be given and what is paid or collected.
steps: Under “RECORD A CONTRACT OR OBLIGATION”, type with whom, what for, the dates, the notice days and who is responsible.
When it shows under “A DECISION IS NEEDED”, open “Decide: renew or end” and click [[Guardar decisión]].
After paying an instalment: [[Ya se pagó: pasar a la siguiente fecha]].
adm-obligaciones.expect: SOLU only warns while deciding still changes what happens. A contract that renews by itself stops warning once the notice date passes. The contract's payments go into the projected cash.

adm-personas.why: Relationship, formal position, pay, absences, assets in their charge and the support the company owes each role.
steps: Administration or Management: open a person and complete “BOND WITH THE COMPANY” and “FORMAL POSITION AND ROLE”.
Each person opens their own file and requests an absence with [[Pedir]].
Administration or Management decide it with [[Aprobar]] or [[No aprobar]].
If someone lacks a tool or an access, record it under [[Registrar algo que falta]], with who resolves it and the next step.
adm-personas.expect: Pay is seen only by Management, Finance and the person themselves, and only Management records it. Nobody decides their own absence. An approved absence leaves that day without capacity in My Plan and shows in Coverage. There are no evaluations here.

adm-autoridad.why: When someone who approves is going to be away, they can lend that authority to another person for a while.
steps: Management: under “LEND AUTHORITY”, choose which authority, from whom, to whom, the dates, the cap and the reason, and click [[Prestar]].
Whoever receives it decides as usual: the screen says they act with delegated authority.
To remove it early: [[Retirar]] with the reason.
adm-autoridad.expect: It ends by itself on the end date. More time is a new version. It never serves to approve what the lender requested, or one's own. The decision keeps whose authority it was.

adm-viajes.why: The mission gives the purpose; Administration authorizes and controls the trip's money.
steps: The traveller requests the budget; Management approves it and chooses which budget it is charged to.
Finance or Management record the advance with [[Registrar anticipo]].
The traveller uploads the expenses with their receipts and sends them for review.
Finance or Management mark each expense [[Válido]] or [[No aceptar]], and then [[Legalizar gastos]].
Under “TRIP SETTLEMENT”, [[Cerrar la liquidación]] with the reference of the payment or the refund.
adm-viajes.expect: No expense counts until someone reviews it. Accepting an expense without a receipt requires the reason. The settlement is valid expenses minus the advance: the company pays the difference or the traveller returns it.

adm-contabilidad.why: SOLU delivers reliable facts to the accounting system; it does not replace it.
steps: Choose the file: customer invoices, supplier invoices, money received, payments made, costs or assets.
Choose the dates and click [[Descargar]].
Review “FILES DOWNLOADED”: it records who took what and when.
adm-contabilidad.expect: The file opens in Excel and says at the top the period and who downloaded it. Downloading changes nothing in SOLU.

adm-politicas.why: One place to see every rule with numbers: which version applies, since when, who set it and where it is changed.
steps: Open [[Políticas]] and review the register; each name leads to where it is changed.
Management: change the Administration policy, write why and click [[Guardar como versión nueva]].
Open [[Eventos]] to see what happened, in business words.
adm-politicas.expect: A change never recalculates what was already decided. Events appear by themselves when someone records, approves or reconciles something.

users.why: Create user accounts and manage the sample data.
steps: Fill in name, email and role, and click [[Crear usuario]].
Load the sample data with [[Cargar datos de ejemplo]]. Once it is loaded, [[Quitar datos de ejemplo]] shows in its place.
users.expect: The new person can sign in. Sample records say (ejemplo).

trabajos.why: What SOLU does by itself every 15 minutes: read email replies, tidy the parts catalogue and send reminders.
steps: Open the tab.
Look at the last round and whether anything failed.
trabajos.expect: A new round appears every 15 minutes.

profile.why: Your details, language and calendar connection.
steps: Update your details, your language and your working hours, and [[Guardar]].
Click [[Conectar mi calendario]] and sign in with your own Microsoft account.
Under “On-screen guide (training)” you can turn the search-bar guide off or on.
profile.expect: The connected calendar is only your own Outlook mailbox. After connecting it, your agenda blocks show in Outlook.

firmas-correo.t: Email signatures: upload the picture of your signature and choose which one to use
firmas-correo.why: Upload the picture of your signature once so it goes on the emails you send from SOLU; with several signatures, each with its name, you choose which goes on each email.
steps: Open TEAM → Settings → My profile and go down to the “Email signatures” box.
Choose the picture of your signature (PNG, JPG or GIF, up to 500 KB), type a name (for example “Formal”) and click [[Subir firma]].
To keep several, upload another one with another name. The one marked “Usual one” comes chosen on every email; change it with [[Usar siempre esta]].
Change a name by typing it and clicking [[Guardar nombre]]. Remove a signature with [[Quitar]].
When sending a template email, below the message, under “Signature”, choose which one goes, or “No signature picture”.
firmas-correo.expect: The picture goes inside the email, below the text. Only you see and use your signatures. The first one you upload becomes the usual one. You can keep up to 8. If you remove the usual one, the oldest one left takes its place.

modo-prueba.t: Test mode: show or hide the test information
modo-prueba.why: To work with real information without the sample data and the test customers filling the lists, counts and totals. Nothing is deleted.
steps: Open TEAM → Settings → My profile and find the “Test mode” box.
Click [[Desactivar modo prueba]]. From then on you only see real information, and the TEST MODE label leaves the top bar.
To see the test information again, click [[Activar modo prueba]] in the same box.

Management and Commercial Director: to choose which customers and suppliers are test, click “Choose which customers and suppliers are test”, tick or untick the “Test” box of each one and click [[Guardar información de prueba]].
modo-prueba.expect: With test mode off, lists, counts and totals leave out the data marked “(ejemplo)” and the customers and suppliers marked as test, with their Needs, quotes, orders, invoices, payments and tasks. It only changes for you. A test record you open by its direct link still opens. Customers whose name starts with “Prueba” were marked as test from the start.

eq-mirol.why: What the company expects from your role and what you can expect from the company, in six blocks, and the line that joins the company's purpose with what you do today.
steps: Open [[EQUIPO]]: you land on My role. At the top are the groups: My development, My team, Organisation and Setup.
Read “My line of contribution”: company purpose, function, role, expected results and today's actions.
Go through the six blocks in order: our company, my function, my role, how I am expected to do it, how I know I am doing well and how I can grow.
When you have talked it over with your leader, click [[Ya las revisé con mi líder]].
If an expectation cannot be met because something is missing, open it at the bottom: which expectation, what is missing, who resolves it and the next step.
eq-mirol.expect: With the sample data, sign in as Paola to see it complete. The agreement shows its version and since when it applies. If you do not have a role agreement yet, SOLU says so as a "role clarity gap" and shows the company and the function. The month's goals are the same as in Commercial → My goals.

eq-desarrollo.why: A few priorities, well supported: who I need to become (BE), what I need to do better (DO) and what knowledge or experience I need to build (HAVE).
steps: Write what you want to develop for, choose who supports you and click [[Abrir el ciclo]].
Under “Add an objective”, write the goal, what evidence will show it was achieved, the next move and the review date. Choose who sees it.
When something happens that shows it, use “Add evidence”.
To finish it: “Close the objective” and [[Logrado, con la evidencia registrada]], or write the reason and [[Cerrar con este motivo]].
Under “COMMITMENTS”, note who does what, what will show it and by when.
eq-desarrollo.expect: A goal without expected evidence, next move or review date is not saved. It is not counted as achieved without evidence. Each dimension has a maximum number of priorities. “WHAT ASKS FOR ATTENTION” warns if a conversation is missing or a date has passed.

eq-360.t: My 360 and who sees each line
eq-360.why: Who you are, your talents, what you do and what you have. You decide who sees each line.
steps: In each block (BE, Talents, DO, HAVE, History, Reflections), open “Add”, write and choose who sees it.
To change it later: “change who sees it or remove”.
If you want, add an assessment (CliftonStrengths, DISC, Enneagram or other) with its source and date.
Under “CHARACTER: EVIDENCE”, record a behaviour: what you did, in which situation and on which day.
eq-360.expect: Private is seen only by you. Shared is seen by your leader and your mentor. Organisation is also seen by Management and counts in the talent map. A reflection starts private. An assessment is never organisational, and the zodiac shows as "just for fun". Character evidence that rests on a test is not saved.

eq-conversaciones.why: The 1:1, mentoring and the checkpoints on days 0, 30, 60 and 90, with the agenda already built.
steps: Under “Schedule a conversation”, choose the type, the date and with whom, and click [[Programar]].
Open it: the agenda brings the pending commitments, the current focus and the new evidence since last time.
During the conversation, add the commitments that come up.
When you finish, write what was discussed, the date of the next one and click [[Cerrar]].
eq-conversaciones.expect: It does not close without the next conversation or the reason why none is needed. The agenda is kept as it was. Only the two people in the conversation can open it.

eq-feedback.why: Ask for and give feedback in four parts: continue, start, improve and reduce.
steps: Under [[Pedir feedback]], choose who and what that person is to you (leader, peer, mentor, another function), and click [[Pedir]].
Whoever receives it sees it in their bell and answers it under “FEEDBACK ASKED OF YOU”.
To give it without being asked: “GIVE FEEDBACK UNASKED”.
On feedback you received, open [[Convertir en oportunidad de desarrollo]].
eq-feedback.expect: At least one of the four parts must be written. Feedback carries the name of whoever gives it. The person and their leader read it.

metas-equipo.t: Organise team goals: each person's monthly recipe
metas-equipo.why: See every person's recipe for the month in one list, and write it or change it for them.
steps: Open [[EQUIPO]], then [[Mi equipo]] and click [[Organizar metas del equipo]].
Read the list “EACH PERSON'S RECIPE”: sales goal, so far, average sale, deals, quotes and activities per day. Whoever has no recipe this month shows “No recipe”.
On the person's row, click “Write recipe” (or “Change recipe” if they already have one). Their “MONTHLY RECIPE” opens above.
Type the “Sales goal for the month (USD)” and “Your average sale (USD)”, and check the four ratios. The chart changes as you type.
Click [[Guardar el recetario]].
metas-equipo.expect: SOLU confirms “Recipe saved.” and the person's row shows the new figures and your name under “Saved by”. The person sees that recipe in COMERCIAL → Mis metas and can change it. “Previous month” and “Next month” change the month; a month already closed doesn't change. Whoever is not in Management, Administration or Commercial Direction doesn't see this tab. The “Sum of goals per company” column and the “Team total” row add up what each person set customer by customer in “GOALS PER COMPANY”.

eq-miequipo.t: My team's development (for those who lead)
eq-miequipo.why: Each person you support: their focus, the last and next conversation, the commitments and what needs attention.
steps: Open [[Mi equipo]].
Read each person's “attention” column.
Click the name to open their development, or "schedule" to book the conversation.
eq-miequipo.expect: It shows the people you are the formal leader or team leader of. They go in alphabetical order. It never shows private reflections, assessments or goals the person kept private.

eq-claridad.why: Per person: their role, level, agreement version, whether they reviewed the expectations, key gaps, authority problems and next development. And where the structure has a hole.
steps: Management: on a person's row, open [[Asignar]], choose the role agreement, the level, the leader, the date and the reason, and click [[Guardar]].
For a temporary assignment, tick «Es un rol temporal» and set the end date.
Read “WHERE THE ROLE STRUCTURE HAS A HOLE”.
Under “Key gaps”, use [[ver o registrar]] to compare the agreement with the evidence.
eq-claridad.expect: Whoever has no agreement shows at the top as a role clarity gap. The temporary role does not erase the base role. A gap result without evidence stays as "not enough evidence". The leader sees only their people and does not assign.

eq-continuidad.why: Who holds each role, who can step in if they are missing and who is being prepared.
steps: Open [[Continuidad y sucesión]].
On a role, open [[Nombrar un respaldo o un sucesor]], choose the person and write what shows they can do the role.
Read the four answers: capability, authority, access and availability, each with its reason.
At the top, review the absences of the next 30 days and who covers.
eq-continuidad.expect: A critical role, or one held by a single person, without a qualified backup shows as a continuity risk. They are four answers, not a score. The reason for an absence is not shown. An absence without notice and without coverage reaches the leader in the bell.

eq-talentos.why: What the team is made of and where knowledge depends on a single person.
steps: Open [[Mapa de talentos]].
Read “KNOWLEDGE THAT DEPENDS ON ONE PERSON”.
Review talents, skills and knowledge, with who has them.
eq-talentos.expect: It only includes what each person marked as Organisation. It groups what was written with the same words. It is not a label on anyone.

eq-roles.why: The agreement of each position: it is not a task list, it is what the role must achieve, what it answers for, what it decides, its limits and what the company owes it.
steps: Open [[Acuerdos de rol]] and go into the sample one to see a complete one.
Management: under [[Crear un acuerdo de rol]], complete at least purpose, results, responsibilities, what it can decide and limits, one thing per line.
Write the principles as behaviours: "Truth: do not promise a date without operational validation".
Write since when it applies and why, and click [[Publicar el acuerdo de rol]].
To change it, open it and use [[Publicar una versión nueva de este acuerdo]].
eq-roles.expect: Without the five parts it is not published. A behaviour written as a rating (for example "4/5") is rejected. Publishing never deletes: the earlier version stays in the history. If the agreement asks for an authority the policies do not give that role, SOLU points it out.

eq-organizacion.why: Whether the company is supporting the growth of its people and whether it has someone to continue each role.
steps: Open [[Desarrollo organizacional]].
Read “DEVELOPMENT BY FUNCTION”: how many people have a role agreement and an active cycle.
Read “SUCCESSION AND ROLES WITH NO BACKUP”.
At the bottom, in the policy, change a value, write why and click [[Guardar como versión nueva]].
eq-organizacion.expect: They are counts, with no names or content of anyone's development. The policy starts with the values of the official document. Cycles already open keep their dates.

inf-desempeno.why: How you are doing, what needs movement and whether you are building enough future, on one page.
steps: Open [[INFORMES]] in the menu.
Read “RESULT AND FUTURE”: this month's figure, the goal, the pace and the previous month.
Click [[¿Cómo se calcula?]] next to any figure.
Review “MONEY I MUST MOVE” and “RISKS AND WHAT IS COMING”; each line leads to the Need.
inf-desempeno.expect: It says whether the month is closed or provisional and the calculation date. Nothing is written for this report.

inf-equipo.why: Who needs help and with what, to prepare the conversation with evidence.
steps: Management: under “SET UP TEAMS”, create the team, choose its leader and add the people.
The leader opens [[Equipo]] and sees each person with their pace on each goal.
Click a person to see their full report.
inf-equipo.expect: People go in alphabetical order; there is no score or ranking. Each person's commissions are not shown. The team gives no permission to edit or approve.

inf-diccionario.why: Each figure has a single definition: what it means, how it is calculated, where it comes from and who answers for it.
steps: Open [[Diccionario de métricas]].
Find a metric and read its formula and its source.
inf-diccionario.expect: The same metric means the same on every screen.

inf-pulso.why: The month by function: what we discovered, what we transacted, what we delivered and what resources we looked after, against the previous month.
steps: Open [[Pulso del negocio]]: it shows the last finished month.
Click any line to go to its detail.
Management: when the month has been reviewed, click the button that starts with [[Emitir el informe de]] (it names the month and ends in "with these figures").
inf-pulso.expect: Figures marked "today's snapshot" are not compared with the previous month. An issued month is not recalculated by itself; reopening it asks for a reason.

inf-futuro.t: Future pulse and where to step in
inf-futuro.why: What is coming, in four futures that are not added together: market, commercial, contracted and financial. And a short list of matters where Management must decide.
steps: Open [[Pulso del futuro]].
Start with “WHERE MANAGEMENT SHOULD STEP IN”: each matter says its impact, who carries it and what to decide.
Review each future by term: already past, 30 days, 31 to 90 and beyond.
inf-futuro.expect: There are no probabilities or invented forecasts: they are counts and amounts in their real state.

inf-emitir.t: Issue the month's report and download it
inf-emitir.why: At the end of each month, Management receives an email saying the report is ready. Management reviews it and issues it from SOLU; the figures are kept as the month's official report.
steps: In the first week of the month Management receives the email "SOLU: the report for … is ready to issue". The email carries no figures.
Open [[Pulso del negocio]] and review the month.
At the bottom, under “ISSUE THE MONTH'S REPORT”, click the button that starts with [[Emitir el informe de]] (it names the month and ends in "with these figures").
To get the file, click [[Descargar este informe (archivo para Excel)]]. The same link is in the Builder.
inf-emitir.expect: If the month was already issued, no email arrives. The file says at the top the period, when it was calculated, who downloaded it and the filters. People outside Management and Finance do not see the download link.

inf-funcion.why: How Commercial did in the month, why Eságara is under the goal and what SOLU found in the data.
steps: Open [[Función Comercial]].
Read “WHAT SOLU FOUND”: each finding says whether it is a fact or an inference; click [[Ver la evidencia]].
Under “WHY ESÁGARA IS BELOW GOAL” review how much sales under the threshold explain and how much remains unexplained.
Use the month arrows to see an earlier month.
inf-funcion.expect: The cause and the unexplained part add up exactly to the gap against the goal. People go in alphabetical order and add up to the function's figure. Without goals set, SOLU does not invent one.

inf-administracion.why: On one page: receivables by age, what must come in and go out, customers over their limit, what the bank shows unexplained, Eságara and commissions.
steps: Open [[Administración]] inside REPORTS.
Review receivables by age: not due, 1 to 30, 31 to 60 and over 60 days.
Click each block's link to go where the work is done.
inf-administracion.expect: The receivable total is the same as in Receivables. It is today's snapshot. The bank balance, projected cash and budget are in Administration. The “INTERNAL SPENDING” block shows what the company bought for itself this month (total, products, services and purchases without a receipt) and the chart of the last 6 months; click a month to open its detail under Operations → Internal purchases.

inf-constructor.why: Build your own report of sales and Eságara by month, by customer or by negotiator, and save the question to come back to it.
steps: Open [[Constructor]].
Choose the dates under “From” and “until”, and how to group under “Group by”; if you want, filter by negotiator or customer.
Click [[Ver informe]].
Type a name and click [[Guardar vista]]. Management, Direction and the money roles can tick the “Share with everyone” box.
Open the view from “SAVED VIEWS”; delete it with [[Borrar]] if it is yours.
inf-constructor.expect: The rows add up to the total. A view saves the question, not the figures: each person sees only their Needs and those of the teams they lead. The order is alphabetical, not a ranking.

ger-inicio.why: In under a minute: what is waiting for your decision, how the business is going, what is coming and where resources are exposed.
steps: Open [[GERENCIA]]. At the top are the groups: Today, Direction, Review, Governance and Money.
Start with “Decisions waiting for you”: each one says the question, why now, how much it weighs, the options, the facts and the assumptions.
Go through the “Business pulse” (six blocks) and the “Future pulse”: each figure leads to where its detail is.
At the bottom, “RESOURCES AND RISK EXPOSED”: seven separate views.
ger-inicio.expect: With the sample data loaded you will see one decision requested by Paola and another to review. What is normal does not appear: only what your authority can change. There are no probabilities or a score that joins the risks. The figures are the same as in Reports and Administration. Direction does not see the people block.

ger-decisiones.t: Ask Management for a decision, and decide
ger-decisiones.why: When something is beyond what you can resolve, you ask here with what Management needs to decide without asking you. What is decided stays written with its reason.
steps: Open [[Decisiones]] and go down to “ASK MANAGEMENT FOR A DECISION” (if you are in Management it is called “OPEN A DECISION”).

Write the question, the context, how much it weighs, at least two options (one per line), the facts and, separately, the assumptions. Click [[Pedir la decisión]] (Management sees [[Abrir la decisión]]).
Management: open it, write what is decided, why, what is expected to happen, when it is reviewed and who is left in charge, and click [[Registrar la decisión]].
If it is no longer needed, whoever asked withdraws it with the reason.
Also from a Need: at the top, [[Pedir a Gerencia]] opens the request with the Need already linked.
ger-decisiones.expect: With a single option it is not saved: doing nothing counts as an option. A decision made is never edited or deleted. Each person sees the ones they asked for or were left in charge of; Management and Direction see them all. The bell notifies Management.

ger-revisar-decision.t: Review a decision against what happened
ger-revisar-decision.why: A decision is learned from when what was expected is compared with what really happened.
steps: When the follow-up date arrives, the decision shows on the Home and in the bell.
Open it and, under “WHAT REALLY HAPPENED”, write what happened and choose how it turned out. Click [[Guardar la revisión]].
If the decision changed, open [[La decisión cambió: escribir una versión nueva]], write why and [[Guardar como versión nueva]].
ger-revisar-decision.expect: If it is still early, SOLU asks for the new review date. The earlier version stays visible, marked as replaced, with what it said.

ger-cierre.why: The day, the week or the month, starting with the future: what must be decided and what is coming; then result, highest value, risks, cash and delivery, and capacity.
steps: Open [[Cierre ejecutivo]] and choose Day, Week, Month or Quarter.
Use [[anterior]] and "next" to move between periods.
In Quarter, also read “QUARTERLY REVIEW: DIRECTION AND RESOURCES”: each priority and whether it was reviewed, and the resource-allocation decisions.
ger-cierre.expect: The future, result, value and cash blocks count what happened within the period. Decisions, risks and capacity show how things stand today. They are company totals, with no list of people. In block 6, “Internal spending” adds up the approved internal purchases of the period and compares them with the period before; the amount is a link to the month's report.

ger-puente.why: From what someone saw coming to the money in the bank, in eight stages. And the highest-value items that deserve your attention.
steps: Open [[Lo que viene]] and read the eight stages from left to right.
Under “VISIBLE FUTURE ESÁGARA”, look at each bucket with the basis it is calculated on.
Under “High-value deals”, each row says why it is on the list.
At the bottom, “CONCENTRATION RISK”: what share depends on a single customer or supplier.
ger-puente.expect: There is no total: the stages are not added because they do not have the same certainty. Opportunities and needs are counted, not valued. Receivables equal those in Receivables.

ger-prioridades.why: The chosen direction: why, what result is sought, what signals announce it, who answers for it and which real records carry it.
steps: Management: under “NEW PRIORITY”, write the title, why, the result, the horizon, the owner and at least one early signal. Click [[Crear la prioridad]].
Link it to a customer, a Need, an exploration, a decision or a scenario with [[Vincular]].
The owner writes how it is really going under “Review” and [[Guardar la revisión]].
When it ends: [[Cerrarla: lograda o abandonada]], with the reason.
ger-prioridades.expect: With no linked record, SOLU says it is only an intention. Signals tied to a metric show its value today or for the month. It is not a task list.

ger-cuentas.why: The customers Management decides to follow closely: why they matter, who covers them, what is in progress, how they pay, their risks, where they can grow and the next management move.
steps: Management: under “CHOOSE A STRATEGIC ACCOUNT”, choose the customer, write why and click [[Elegir como estratégica]].
Open [[Actualizar]] and write the next management move with its date.
Click the name to go to the customer's full file.
ger-cuentas.expect: Only the reason and the next move are kept here; everything else is read from the customer's file. Without a next move, or with the date past, the account "needs attention".

ger-escenarios.why: Compare options before deciding: accept a low-Eságara deal, raise a credit limit, finance a purchase, buy stock, assign people or speed up an import.
steps: Under “NEW SCENARIO”, write the question and the facts that hold for every option.
For each option write its assumptions and a range (minimum and maximum) of what it can leave.
Click [[Guardar el escenario]] and then [[Llevarlo a una decisión]].
ger-escenarios.expect: A single figure is not accepted: a scenario is not a forecast. If the ranges overlap, SOLU says so and names no winner. Once the decision is made, the scenario stays as it was.

ger-revision.why: The month's tour: market, commercial, operations, administration and team. In each one, the same three questions.
steps: Open [[Revisión por función]] and choose the function.
Read “What changed?” against the previous month.
Read “Why”: each cause says whether it is a fact or an inference.
Read «Qué requiere decisión» and open the one that applies.
ger-revision.expect: The figures are those of the Business pulse. When SOLU finds no cause in the records, it says so. Only Management sees the Team review.

ger-sistema.why: It is not the month's result: it is whether the company is getting better at generating, converting, winning, delivering and collecting.
steps: Open [[Desempeño del sistema]].
Read each row: the last 90 days against the 270 before, with the number of cases.
ger-sistema.expect: With fewer than 5 cases it says "little data". It compares the company with itself: no person appears.

ger-personas.why: Where the company depends on a single person, and where someone is away with nobody covering.
steps: Open [[Personas y capacidad]].
Review the absences of the next 30 days and who covers.
Review key relationships without a backup and roles with a single holder.
Use the links to assign coverage or define a backup.
ger-personas.expect: It does not show the reason for an absence, pay or personal notes. The workload list is in alphabetical order and counts open work, not activity.

ger-identidad.why: Why we exist, what we offer and how we behave. It is the starting point of each function and each role.
steps: Open [[Identidad]] and read the purpose, the value proposition, the attributes and the principles.
Management: under “PUBLISH A NEW VERSION”, change the text, write since when it applies and why, and click [[Publicar como versión nueva]].
Under “HISTORY”, read what changed between versions.
ger-identidad.expect: It starts with the official identity as version 1. Publishing deletes nothing. The principles do not yet say what behaviour is expected: it is written next to each one, after a colon.

ger-funciones.why: What each function exists for, what it delivers, what it decides by itself, what it hands to the others and who answers. And where the structure has a hole.
steps: Open [[Funciones y roles]] and read the five functions.

Management: on a function, open [[Publicar una versión nueva de esta carta]], choose who answers and complete what it delivers, what it answers for, what it decides, what it counts on and its interfaces.
At the top, “WHERE THE STRUCTURE HAS A HOLE” goes down as you complete it.
ger-funciones.expect: Each function's purpose is the official text and is not edited. An interface that names only one side shows as ambiguous. At the bottom, the role-agreements table says which are clear; they are written in Team → Role agreements.

ger-politicas.why: Which rules apply, which exceptions are waiting, what the highest level approved and which exceptions repeat so often that the rule deserves a review.
steps: Open [[Políticas y autoridad]].
Read “Exceptions that repeat” and open the cases of a pattern.
Management: at the bottom, under “MANAGEMENT POLICY”, change a value, write why and click [[Guardar como versión nueva]].
ger-politicas.expect: Operating numbers are not changed from here: each policy is changed on its own screen. Management always stays among those who publish the identity and the functions.

ger-junta.why: For partners or board members: they see the direction, how the business is going, what is coming, the risks and what management decided, without being able to change anything.
steps: Management: in TEAM → People & data, create the person and choose the role "Board or assembly (read only)".
Management can see what that person will see under [[Vista de Junta]].
The person signs in and lands directly on their view. They can also read Identity and Functions, and change their profile.
ger-junta.expect: They do not see people, pay, commissions or any customer's file. If they try to open another screen, SOLU sends them back to their view. They cannot save anything or download files.

ger-empresas.why: When more than one company sells, the same figures separated by company.
steps: On the Management home, go down to “BY SELLING COMPANY”.
Click a company: it opens “What is coming” with only its Needs, invoices and purchases.
Go back to “All companies” with the tab at the top.
ger-empresas.expect: It only shows when more than one company has data or is active; today only the United States company sells, so it is normal not to see it. The companies add up to the total. Future opportunities do not belong to a company.

ger-correo.t: Email: the executive close is ready
ger-correo.why: SOLU emails Management when the close is ready, so nobody has to remember to open it.
steps: Management: under “MANAGEMENT POLICY”, choose the email's rhythm: on Mondays, every working day if something is waiting, or never.
Write why and click [[Guardar como versión nueva]].
On Monday morning the email "SOLU: last week's executive close is ready" arrives, with the link.
ger-correo.expect: The email carries counts and the link, never amounts or names. It reaches only people with the Management role, after 7 in the morning and never at the weekend. It starts on "Mondays".

insights.why: Each chart answers a management question: do customers get results? do we keep promises? what is coming and how certain is it? where is Eságara lost? which Recoveries are open?
steps: Change the view: Month, Forward, Causes, Recovery.
Filter by person, sector or certainty, and [[Aplicar]].
Click a bar or a name to go into the Need or the cause.
Use the "Ask SOLU" buttons to see causes and dependencies.
insights.expect: During the first 7 days of the month, Month shows the previous month. There are no counts of messages, calls or time connected. That is intentional.

comisiones.why: Commissions on confirmed results, split 50/50 for now.
steps: Choose the person and the period, and click [[Ver]].
Review and click [[Enviar a Gerencia]].
Corrections create a new version with [[Crear versión]].

m12-reparto.t: Who receives the commission of a sale
m12-reparto.why: The commission pool is split between Commercial and Operations, and Management names the people of each function.
steps: Open a Need's Real Eságara page.
See who receives today and what percentage of the pool.
Management: [[Cambiar el reparto]], name up to three people per function with their percentage and the reason, and [[Guardar reparto]].
m12-reparto.expect: With nobody named, whoever carries the Need receives everything. Within each function the percentages must add up to 100. What is already approved or paid does not change.

m12-liquidacion.why: Everything that can be paid today, person by person, with its calculation; it is approved together and the payment is recorded.
steps: Open [[Liquidación]] and review “TO APPROVE TODAY”.
Management or Commercial Direction: choose the month and click [[Aprobar liquidación]].
When it is paid: type the reference and [[Registrar pago]].
m12-liquidacion.expect: The collection commission appears in parts, as the customer pays. Nobody approves their own lines. Approving twice duplicates nothing.

m12-numeros.why: The commission rate, the Commercial / Operations split and the cost of money are changed here, with Management's approval.
steps: Open My profile and, under Setup, click the link.
Finance, Administration or Management: type the new values, since when they apply and the reason, and [[Enviar propuesta a Gerencia]].
Management: [[Aprobar cambio]] or [[Rechazar]].
m12-numeros.expect: Nothing changes until Management approves. A date before today is rejected. What is already calculated is not recalculated.

m12-rentabilidad.why: What the month leaves and what the open deals leave, how much goes to commissions, what remains afterwards and why Eságara changed.
steps: Open [[Rentabilidad]].
Read the three figures at the top and click one to see its detail.
Review «Por cliente»: the sale next to what it leaves.
m12-rentabilidad.expect: It is ordered by sale; it is not a ranking. Only Management, Direction, Finance and Administration see it.

m12-cierre.why: Which Needs can be closed today, what is missing on the others and which commissions are ready.
steps: Open [[Cierre y comisiones]].
Under “READY TO CLOSE”, open one and mark it final.
Under “SOMETHING MISSING TO CLOSE”, read what is missing and open the Need to resolve it.
m12-cierre.expect: Each line leads to the screen where it is resolved.

auth-rangos.why: Up to what amount each person can authorize alone, and who must authorize above that: a colleague, MMS and mentor, or Management.
steps: Management: open the ranges, review the values (today they are those of 2025) and assign each person's level.
On a Need, open “Authorisation by level”: SOLU converts the sale to pesos with the day's TRM and says who must authorize.
Click [[+ Registrar autorización]] and type who authorized.
auth-rangos.expect: SOLU informs and keeps the record; it blocks no step. If whoever carries the Need has no level, it says so.

search.why: Jump to any customer, Need, invoice, supplier or part.
steps: Press [[Ctrl K]] and type or paste part of a name, a code, a tax ID or an invoice number.
Press Enter. If there is a single result, SOLU opens it directly.
search.expect: A code or a number always searches records. If you type something you need to do, guides also appear (see "On-screen guide").

guia-pantalla.why: Type what you need to do and SOLU takes you to where it starts and shows you the steps of this guide over the real screen, marking where to click.
steps: If it is your first day: in MY DAY, the «¿Primera vez en SOLU?» box has four things to try, each with its [[Guíame]] button. Remove it with [[Ya conozco SOLU: ocultar]].
For everything else, click [[¿Cómo hago…?]] (at the top) or the search bar without typing anything: the everyday work appears, each item with its [[Guíame]] button.
Type "make invoice" (or "hacer factura"). On the first row click [[Desde el inicio · 8 etapas]]: SOLU opens the Needs board with the guide in the corner.
Follow the steps with [[Siguiente paso]]. The numbered blue ring marks the button or tab the step names.
If the step is on another screen, follow the dotted line or use the guide's "Take me to…" button.
If your case is already further along, tap its stage number in the guide. With [[Solo esta parte]] you see a single function.
To turn it off: TEAM → Setup → My profile and [[Apagar la guía de entrenamiento]]. Turn it on in the same place with [[Encender la guía de entrenamiento]].
guia-pantalla.expect: The guide stays with you as you change screens and can be minimised or closed. It never clicks for you. Turning it off only changes it for you: record search stays the same.

colores.t: Colours: where you are, what can be clicked and what needs you
colores.why: Colour has three jobs: say which module you are in, show what can be clicked and signal the state of each thing.
steps: Look at the menu: each module has its colour, and the module you are in is filled.
Open two different modules: the colour of the line under the top bar and of the band with the module and section name changes.
Move the cursor over a table: the row that leads somewhere turns blue.
In My Day, look at each section's title: amber is "needs you", blue is "to move", green is "waiting with control".
colores.expect: Green, amber and red still mean protected, attention and risk. Purple is still only for SOLU's help. On the Needs board the columns get bluer as the Need advances; "PO accepted" is green.

ask.t: Ask SOLU and report a defect
ask.why: Find records fast, ask it to guide you to do something, and tell us when SOLU made you repeat work or showed noise.
steps: Click [[Pregúntale a SOLU]] and type a question or a name.
Ask how to do something, for example "how do I make an invoice?": at the top "I'll guide you on screen" appears with [[Desde el inicio · 8 etapas]] and [[Solo esta parte]].
Type "training" or "help" to see the everyday-work guides, each with [[Guíame]].
At the bottom, open "Report a SOLU defect", describe what happened and send.
ask.expect: When you pick a guide, the panel closes and the guide stays in the corner. With the training guide turned off in My profile, the panel says so and links to where it is turned on. Reports show in Insights, under product health.

bell-lang.why: Know what needs attention everywhere and work in your language.
steps: Click the bell to see the alerts of every module.
Change the language with [[ES]] or [[EN]], at the top right.
A thin blue bar at the top shows while a page loads or a form is saved, and the pressed button says "Saving…" so it cannot be pressed twice.
bell-lang.expect: The language change applies to every screen; on PDFs you choose EN or ES.

glosario.t: Glossary: an information bubble on every term
glosario.why: Every SOLU term (Need, Eságara, PO, Delivery note, Credit limit, Reconcile…) carries an "i" bubble that explains what it means on that screen and what it means in general.
steps: Open any screen: terms show with a dotted underline. Move the cursor over one: an "i" bubble appears next to the word.
Click the bubble, or the underlined word when it is plain text. Read “On this screen” and “In general”.
Close it with the X, with Esc or by clicking outside.
To see every term: at the top right, open the menu under your name and click [[Glosario de términos]].
To remove the bubbles: on the Glossary page, [[Ocultar los globos en las pantallas]]. Show them again in the same place with [[Mostrar los globos en las pantallas]].
glosario.expect: The same term explains different things depending on where you are: "Need" in the title of the board's first column is the stage; in Market it is when a signal becomes a Need. There is one bubble per term in each block of the screen, not on every mention. Hiding them applies to that browser, not to the person. On a phone or tablet, where there is no cursor, the "i" bubbles always show. Words inside a button, a link or the title of a folding section carry no bubble, so the click always does what the button says.

pendientes-aprobar.why: One list with everything that waits for a decision of yours: authorize a purchase, accept a customer's PO, release a supplier order, verify or approve a payment.
steps: Click your name, top right, and then [[Pendientes por aprobar]]. It is also under TEAM → Settings.
Under “What you must decide”, each line says what needs approval, whose it is and for how much. They are grouped by kind.
Click the blue button on the line (for example [[Abrir y autorizar]]): SOLU takes you to the exact place where it is approved.
There, take the decision with that screen's button (“Approve”, “Accept PO”, “Release Supplier PO”…). When you come back, the line is gone.
pendientes-aprobar.expect: Nothing is approved here: each approval is done on its own screen, with its rules. Below, “What you asked for and waits for someone else” shows what you requested and cannot approve yourself. Management may authorize a purchase and verify or approve a payment it requested itself.

ops-compras-internas.t: Internal purchases: what the company buys for itself
ops-compras-internas.why: A mouse, a laptop, staples, a training session, maintenance: not for sale and not for a customer. It is recorded with its receipt, approved, and enters the month's spending report.
steps: Under OPERATIONS → Buy → Requirements, at the top, click [[+ Compra interna]]. You can also use the “Internal purchases” tab.

Answer in the order on screen: “1 · Is it a product or a service?”, “2 · Category (optional)” with “Where or from whom? (optional)”, and “3 · What was bought?”. Clicking that box opens the “EARLIER PURCHASES” list: if this purchase was recorded before, choose it and SOLU fills in the form; if it is new, type it.

Under “4 · How much did it cost?” type the amount and check the “Currency”; if you chose an earlier purchase, confirm the amount is the one on this receipt. “5 · What is it for? (optional)” helps the approver. Under “6 · It was already bought” leave the tick with its date; if it is a request, untick it.
Under “7 · Receipt or invoice” upload the photo or PDF of the receipt and click [[Enviar compra interna]]. It shows under “My internal purchases” as “Awaiting decision”.
The approver sees it under “Waiting for your approval” (and in Pending approvals): they click [[Revisar y aprobar]], look at the receipt in the RECEIPTS block and click [[Aprobar]].
For month end, go down to “INTERNAL SPENDING REPORT”: total, products and services, the 6-month chart, where it went and who bought. [[Descargar para Excel]] downloads the month's detail.
ops-compras-internas.expect: Only approved purchases that were already bought count in the report, in the month of the purchase and in dollars (another currency is converted at the day's rate). If the receipt is missing, the list marks it in red and it is uploaded later with “Upload receipt”. Finance, Administration or Management approve; whoever recorded it does not approve it, except Management. The report is seen by Finance, Administration, Direction and Management. The total also shows under REPORTS → Administration and MANAGEMENT → Executive close. Every purchase sent is saved under “EARLIER PURCHASES” for the whole team, so nobody types it twice; the amount is only copied from your own purchases (Finance, Administration, Direction and Management see everyone's). “Start blank” clears what was copied. The category list is in alphabetical order, with “Other” last.

ruta-pedido.t: Order route: the process as a menu
ruta-pedido.why: The stations of an order in the order they happen, each with its number of open cases, so you know where the work is and where to go.
steps: Open [[COMERCIAL]] or [[OPERACIONES]]. Under the tabs is the “Order route” strip, with the numbered stations.
Read the number next to each station: those are the cases open there right now.
Click a station to open its list. The station you are on is highlighted.
ruta-pedido.expect: The number of Needs is the same as “In progress” on the board. A station without a number is not counted yet (Find supplier, Purchase orders and Delivery notes). The numbers update when you change screens, at most once a minute.

nuevo-menu.t: + New: create something from any screen
nuevo-menu.why: One button to start what is created most, without looking for which module holds the form.
steps: At the top, click [[+ Nuevo]].
Choose what you want to create: a customer's Need, a customer, a contact, a supplier, a to-do, a visit, a purchase requirement, an internal purchase, a Management decision, a project or a note.
SOLU takes you to the screen where that form is and, if it was inside a closed section, opens it.
nuevo-menu.expect: Only the options for the screens your role can open are shown. The menu closes when you choose.

formularios.t: Forms: what is required, what is wrong and what you already typed
formularios.why: Nobody should fill in a form twice or guess what is required.
steps: Look at a form: required fields carry a red asterisk at the end of their name.
If you fill in a field wrongly, it is marked in red.

If SOLU rejects the form (“What is marked in red is missing”), the fields come back with what you had typed and the notice “I brought back what you had typed” appears. Fix only what the notice says and save again.
formularios.expect: What you type is kept only in your browser tab while you work, never passwords or attached files, and it is deleted when the form is saved. Files have to be attached again. If the form takes you to another screen after the error, it is not brought back.

trm-barra.t: Today's TRM and the currency converter
trm-barra.why: The official rate of the dollar in Colombian pesos always in view, and a converter between the currencies SOLU uses, without leaving where you are.
steps: Look at the top right, next to the bell: “TRM” and today's value.
Click that box: “Convert currencies” opens.
Under “I have” choose the currency you hold and under “I want to buy” the one you are buying. The ⇄ button swaps them.
Type the amount: SOLU shows the result and the rate both ways.
Close it with the “×”.
trm-barra.expect: The TRM in the box is the official one from the Superfinanciera. The converter uses the market rate (Yahoo Finance), which SOLU refreshes every 15 minutes, and says when it is from. It is a reference: the bank's rate on payment day can differ. It saves nothing. If the official TRM does not answer, the box reads “CURRENCIES” and the converter keeps working. It is not shown on a phone.

need-localizar.why: Know exactly which piece it is and where to look for it before asking for prices: with photos, the part number and the suppliers the company has already worked with.
steps: On the Need, open the [[Localizar]] tab. It is step 2 of the path, between Need and Source.
Under “1 · THE PIECE”, type each product's part number and click [[Guardar]]. If a product is missing, open “Add product” and click [[Agregar]].

Under “SEARCH THE INTERNET FOR THE PIECE”, right below the piece, open [[Buscar esta pieza en internet]] (if there are searches already it says “Search the internet for more options”), check what will be searched and click [[Buscar en internet]]: there is no need to go to Market. When it finishes, save the sellers that suit you: they stay here, under “OPTIONS SAVED ON THIS NEED”, with their direct link, their contact and the “Email the seller” button. To go ahead with one, click [[Usar como fuente]]: it becomes a supplier and the Need's source.
Under “2 · PHOTOS”, upload the photo of the nameplate or the piece and click [[Subir fotos]]. The part number or a photo is enough; both is better.
Under “3 · WHERE TO LOOK”, read the list: the suppliers we already work with, ordered for this piece, each with its reason (already sold it to us, quoted it, carries the brand, purchases received).
Under “4 · IS IT LOCATED?”, type which exact piece it is, choose the supplier if you already know and click [[La pieza está localizada]].
To tell the customer how it is going, click [[Escribir al cliente: avance de su solicitud]]: the email comes already written from what SOLU knows about the Need.
need-localizar.expect: On marking it located, the “Locate” step turns green and “Source” comes next. With no part number, the supplier list can only be ordered by general history. Photos stay on the Need and can be attached to the customer's emails. If it was not that piece, “It was not that piece” puts it back to not located.

proy-crear.why: A project is something the team wants to get done. Everyone can see it: what it is for, who started it and who sits at the round table.
steps: In PROJECTS & NOTES → Projects, click [[+ Nuevo proyecto]] (or in the top bar: + New → Project). The “Create a project” form is below the list. If templates have been saved, “Start from a template” is above the form: choosing one fills in the description, objective, tags and priority.
Type “1 · Project name”, “2 · Short description” (what everyone reads in the list) and “3 · Objective”: what you want to achieve and how we will know it was achieved. These three are required.

Under “4 · Priority” choose High, Medium or Low priority: the list of projects is ordered by it. Under “5 · Tags (optional)” tick what it is about: they are grouped by area (General, Committees, Market, Commercial, Operations, Administration, Team and company), or type your own in “Another tag”. Tags with an arrow → are sections of SOLU (Requests, Quotes, Purchase orders, Deliveries…). Under “Is it about a customer or a Need? (optional)” you can link it to a customer or type the Need's code. Under “6 · Desired timeline (optional)” set by when you want each stage finished; if it is just starting, leave the dates empty.

Under “People you want to work with (optional)” tick who you want to invite. If you are Management, you also see “Who is the project for?”, “Saved teams (optional)” and “People assigned to the round table”.
Click [[Crear proyecto]]. The project page opens, in the “Objectives” stage.
proy-crear.expect: The project shows in the list for everyone, with its priority, description, tags, who started it and the round table. The people you invited get a notice on the bell and decide whether to join; people assigned by Management sit at the table right away. If the dates are not in order, SOLU does not save and says so. With a section tag, the project shows “This project is about” with the link to that section, and that section (for example COMMERCIAL → Quotes presented) shows the strip “Projects about this section” with the project and the button “+ Project about this section”.

proy-participar.t: Join a project and take part in the forum
proy-participar.why: Anyone can join any project, without asking permission. Everyone reads the forum; people at the round table write in it.
steps: In PROJECTS & NOTES → Projects, look at the list: it is ordered by priority, and each project shows its stage, description, tags, who started it and the “Round table”. Filter with “All open”, “The ones I am in”, “Closed” or with a tag.
Click [[Unirme]] on the project you are interested in. If someone invited you, it is at the top under “You were invited”, with “Join” and “Not now”.

Once in the project, under “Forum”, type in the box and click [[Publicar]] to start a conversation. With @ and someone's first name (for example @Paola) it reaches their bell. Under “Attach, notify someone or note what the customer said” you can upload photos or a PDF and tick who to notify.

To answer someone, click “Reply” under their comment, type and click “Post reply”. The reply sits below it, as a thread, and can be replied to in turn. You correct your own comment with “Edit”: it is marked as “edited”.
To bring someone else in, under “Round table” open “Invite people”, tick them and click “Send invitation”. Management sees “Assign people or teams”.
proy-participar.expect: Joining needs no approval and is noted in the forum. In the list, “new comments” tells you people wrote since your last visit. If you open a project without being at the table, you can read everything and come in with “Join the round table”. With “Leave the round table” you step out whenever you want.

proy-linea-fechas.t: A project's timeline, dates and alarms
proy-linea-fechas.why: Every project moves through four stages: Objectives, Planning, Execution and Results. Its meetings, appointments and dated tasks can go to your My Day and your Outlook.
steps: Open a project from the list. At the top, “Timeline” shows the current stage in blue and by when each one is due (“Open, no date” if none was set).
The lead, whoever started it, or Management moves on with the blue “Move to…” button (or goes back with “Back to…”). The change is noted in the forum.
Under “Project dates”, open “+ New date”: choose “What is it?” (Meeting, Appointment or Task to do), type the “Title”, the “Day” and, if it has one, the “Time”. Click [[Agregar fecha]].

On each date, “Put in my My Day” keeps it as your own alarm: you see it in MY DAY → To-dos from now, and in “Your agenda” in MY DAY → Today when the day comes. “Add to Outlook” downloads a calendar file: open it and Outlook saves the meeting.
For an alarm of your own about the project, under “Remind me in My Day” choose the “Day”, type what you want to remember and click [[Poner alarma]].

In the “Results” stage, the lead writes “What was achieved?” and clicks “Save and close the project”. To repeat this kind of project later, under “Save as template” type a name and click [[Guardar plantilla]].
proy-linea-fechas.expect: Each person decides which dates go into their My Day: nobody gets them by force. If your Outlook is connected in My profile, the alarm also goes to your calendar. A closed project moves to “Closed” and the lead can reopen it. The template keeps the description, objective, tags, priority and tasks by stage, with no people or dates.

proy-tareas-avance.t: Tasks by stage and asking for progress
proy-tareas-avance.why: Share out who does what in each stage, and ask how something is going without chasing anyone by chat.
steps: Open a project from the list and go down to “Tasks by stage”. Open “+ New task”, type “What has to be done?”, choose who is “In charge (optional)”, the date “By (optional)” and the “Stage”, and click [[Agregar tarea]].
When a task is ready, click its box: it is crossed out, with the name of whoever ticked it. On the “Timeline”, each stage says how many tasks are done.
To know how another person's task is going, click “Ask for progress” on that task (or on a project date). It reaches their bell and their My Day.

If you are the one asked: in the project, at the top, “You are asked for progress” has four one-click answers: “On track”, “Running late”, “Already done” or “It is blocked”, with an optional line of context.
proy-tareas-avance.expect: The answer is written in the forum for the whole table, and “Already done” marks the task or date as done. “Ask for progress” only shows when the task has someone in charge and it is not you; while it waits for an answer it says “Progress asked”. A task past its date is marked “Overdue”.

proy-reloj.t: Project clock: 14 days without movement, and the extension
proy-reloj.why: A project may go at most 14 days without movement. The clock shows it, and if more time is needed it is asked of Management.
steps: Open a project. Below the timeline, “Project clock” says how many days are left, when the last movement was and until which day it may stay still.
A comment, a date, a task or a stage change count as movement and restart the clock.
If the project needs to wait, open “Request extension”, type “Why does it need more time without movement?”, choose “How many more days?” (7 or 14) and click “Send to Management”.
Management gets it on the bell and in MANAGEMENT → Today → Executive close, block “INTERNAL PROJECTS”. In the project, they click “Approve extension” or “Do not approve” (with the reason).
proy-reloj.expect: In the list, each open project carries its state: “On time”, “N d left without movement”, “Stage past its date” or “No movement for over 14 days”. When it runs out, whoever leads the project gets a notice on the bell. Approving an extension does not count as movement: it only moves the limit date. Only one extension can be waiting at a time, and the decision is noted in the forum.

proy-decisiones-cliente.t: Decisions, pinned conversations and what the customer said
proy-decisiones-cliente.why: So an agreement is not lost among the comments, and to note what a customer said when you chose to talk to them.
steps: In a project's forum, the lead, whoever started it, or Management see two links under each comment: “Mark as decision” and “Pin to top”.
A comment marked as a decision shows above the forum, under “Decisions and agreements”, with a link to it. A pinned conversation stays first.

To note something a customer said: open “Attach, notify someone or note what the customer said”, tick “The customer said this (I am noting it, I talked to them)”, type “Who said it? (optional)” and click [[Publicar]].
proy-decisiones-cliente.expect: What the customer said shows above the forum, under “What the customer said”, with who said it and who noted it. SOLU never writes to the customer from a project: contacting them is each person's decision. If the project is linked to a customer or a Need, its name shows at the top as a link to its record.

proy-mi-trabajo.t: My work in projects and my notices
proy-mi-trabajo.why: One place with what is yours across every project, and you choose what SOLU tells you on its own.
steps: In PROJECTS & NOTES → Projects, at the top, “My work in projects” gathers: “You are asked for progress”, “You were mentioned”, “My next dates (14 days)”, “My open tasks” and “Projects I lead that need attention”. Each line takes you to the exact place.
In MY DAY → Today, the “MY PROJECTS” block shows what is yours today: what you are asked, your dates for today and tomorrow, and what is yours and overdue.
To choose your notices, open TEAM → Setup → My profile, go down to “Notices from my projects”, tick or untick the two boxes and click [[Guardar mis avisos]].
proy-mi-trabajo.expect: On the bell, dates and overdue things come in a single line starting with “Projects:”, not one for each. You always get an invitation, an assignment by Management, an @ mention and the notice that a project you lead has stopped moving. None of this comes by email. The “My work” block only shows when you have something.

proy-equipos.why: A named group of people that Management creates once and adds to any project. It adds to roles, it does not replace them: it gives no permissions and changes nobody's role.
steps: In PROJECTS & NOTES → Saved teams, click [[+ Nuevo equipo]] (only Management sees it).
Type “1 · Team name”, if you want “2 · What it is for (optional)”, tick the “3 · People in the team” and click [[Guardar el equipo]].
When creating a project, under “Saved teams (optional)” tick the team: all its people are assigned to the round table.
In a project that already exists, under “Round table” open “Assign people or teams”, tick the team and click “Assign to the round table”.
To change who is in a team, open “Change name or people” on its card. “Archive” stops offering it for new projects.
proy-equipos.expect: The team stays saved for the next projects, and its name shows in the list of projects and at the round table. Everyone can see the teams; only Management creates, changes and adds them. Changing a team does not take anyone out of, or put anyone into, the projects that already had it.

proy-notas.why: For what you just want to remember. Nobody else sees your notes.
steps: In PROJECTS & NOTES → My notes (or in the top bar: + New → Note), type “1 · What do you want to remember?” and, if needed, the “2 · Detail (optional)”.
For SOLU to remind you, under “3 · Alarm in My Day (optional)” set the “Day” and the “Time”. Click [[Guardar nota]].
Under “PENDING NOTES”, tick the note with ✓ when it is done, or open “Set alarm” to give it another date.
If the note grew and you need more people, click “Turn into a project”: it moves to the list of projects, in everyone's view, and SOLU asks you to write its objective.
proy-notas.expect: The alarm shows in MY DAY → To-dos from now, and in “Your agenda” in MY DAY → Today when the day comes (with no time, it is set for 08:00). Marking the note as done closes its alarms. Not even Management sees another person's notes.

resumen-dia.t: Day summary: what appears when you enter
resumen-dia.why: The first time you enter each day, SOLU shows what fell behind, from the most serious to the least, so you decide where to start.
steps: When you enter SOLU for the first time in the day, the window opens by itself. To see it at another moment, open [[MI DÍA]] and click [[Ver el resumen de hoy]].

Read the groups from top to bottom: in red, what puts a result at risk (deliveries past their promised date, promised payments that did not arrive); in amber, what needs a move. Inside each group, what has waited longest comes first; the days are on the right of each case.
To handle a case, click its button (“Notify” or “Open”). To handle them in order, click “Start with the first case”.
If you lead the team, switch between “Mine” and “Team” at the top right of the window.
resumen-dia.expect: If nothing is overdue, the window does not open by itself. A Need waiting under control (its date still ahead) is not shown. To stop it opening when you enter, untick “Show when I enter each day”; that choice is kept in this browser.

recorrido-casos.t: Today's walk: one case after another
recorrido-casos.why: Handle the cases of the summary in order, without going back to the list after each one.
steps: Open [[MI DÍA]], click [[Ver el resumen de hoy]] and then “Start with the first case” (or the button of any case).
SOLU opens the case and leaves a bar at the bottom: “Today's walk · case 1 of …”. Handle the case on the screen.
Click [[Siguiente caso →]] to move to the next one, or [[← Anterior]] to go back.
Click the name of the case, on the bar, to see the whole list and jump to any of them.
recorrido-casos.expect: On the last case the button reads “Finish the walk” and takes you back to My Day. The X leaves the walk without changing anything. The walk lives in this browser tab: closing it ends the walk.

midia-tablero.t: My board: how you are doing against the previous period
midia-tablero.why: See at a glance which step each open case is at, whether more or less work is coming in than before, what has been open the longest, how much was invoiced in 12 months and which customers bought most.
steps: Open [[MI DÍA]] and find “MY BOARD”, below the greeting.

At the top, the row “open cases, step by step” shows the 11 steps of an order, from Need to Result, with how many cases are at each one and since when. Each case counts once, at the step right after the last one done. Click a step to go to its list.
Pick one of the four cards: Needs, Quotes, Orders to deliver or In transit. Each one says how many are open now, how many are past their date and how many have no follow-up.
Pick the period: [[7 días]], [[30 días]], [[3 meses]] or [[12 meses]]. The blue line is this period; the dashed one, the previous period of the same length.
On the right, look at the age of the open ones and click one under “Open the longest” to open it.

Further down, “Invoiced sales · last 12 months” shows one bar per month with the number of invoices under it, and “Customers that bought most · 12 months” the eight customers with the most invoiced. Click a customer to open their record.
midia-tablero.expect: The large figure on each card is how many were created in the period, with the difference against the previous one. Hover a point or a bar to see its figures, or open “See the figures as a table”. Sales are the value of the invoices issued, in USD, before VAT. Management and the Commercial Director can switch between “Mine” and “Team”.

calendario-casos.t: Case calendar: what happened and where you should be
calendario-casos.why: See any day, past or future: what happened, where each case stood that day, what was kept and what was not, and where each case should be on a future date, with the deadlines SOLU recommends.
steps: Open [[MI DÍA]] and click the [[Calendario de casos]] tab. It opens on the current month, with today marked.

Look at the coloured numbers on each day: red “Not kept”, blue “Dated commitment”, orange “Deadline recommended by SOLU”, green “Kept” and gray “Something that happened”. Hover a day to read it in words.
Click a past day: each case says “That day it was at:” and, if it changed, “today it is at:”, with what happened that day.
Click a future day: each case says “By that day it should be at:” and where it is today. Recommended deadlines say how they were calculated.
Use [[← Mes anterior]] and [[Mes siguiente →]] to change month, and [[Volver a hoy]] to come back. Click a line to open the case.
calendario-casos.expect: Receipt at the warehouse is recommended 4 working days before the promised delivery, the supplier's dispatch those days minus the transit days, and a quote follow-up 7 days after the last contact. They are guides: they do not replace the date the supplier confirms. Management and the Commercial Director can switch between “Mine” and “Team”.

comparar-equipo.t: Compare the team: each person's customers, activity and results
comparar-equipo.why: See each person on the team side by side: how many customers they have in their care, how many were active, how many contacts they made and what they moved in the period.
steps: Open [[MI DÍA]] and click the [[Comparar equipo]] tab. You also get there from “MY BOARD”, with the link “Compare the team →”.
Pick the period: [[30 días]], [[3 meses]] or [[12 meses]].

Read the table: one row per person and one column per figure: Customers in care, Active customers, Contacts made, New Needs, Quotes presented, POs accepted and Invoiced sales. Your row is highlighted and says “You”.
Click a column title to order by it, highest first. “Person” goes back to ordering by name.
Open “What each column counts” to read how each figure is counted.
comparar-equipo.expect: Each figure carries a bar measured against the highest one in its column, and the “Team” row adds everyone up. Everyone sees this page, with the same figures. No score joins the columns.

necesidad-ia.why: Tell the case by voice or in writing and let SOLU fill in the Need, say what still needs asking, propose what to do and prepare the reply to the customer. Nothing is created or sent until you review it.
steps: Open [[COMERCIAL]] and the [[Necesidades]] tab.
In the “New Need” box, to the right of the title, click [[Crear Necesidad con IA]].
Type the case as you would tell a colleague: who is asking, what they need and what for. In Chrome and Edge you can also click [[Dictar]] and speak; when you finish, [[Detener el dictado]].
Click [[Armar la Necesidad]]. SOLU shows what it understood, “What still needs asking the customer” and “What SOLU proposes”.
If it is right, click [[Pasar al formulario]]. If not, [[Volver a contar el caso]].

On the form, check every box: names, part numbers and quantities. If the customer or the contact were not on the list, SOLU leaves “+ Create new customer” and “+ Create new contact” chosen with what it read in the email: check the company name, the person's name, their email and phone. They are created together with the Need.
Click [[Crear Necesidad y revisar el correo]]: the email opens with the reply the AI prepared. Read it, change it and click [[Enviar correo]].
necesidad-ia.expect: The form is filled in and reads “Filled in with AI.” at the top. What still needs asking and the proposal go into “Notes (internal use)”, which never reach the customer. AI does not make things up: what you did not say stays empty. Dictated part numbers often come out wrong: always compare them. Until the company connects its AI key, the button opens the notice “Needs the AI key (API key).” The window closes only with the “×” in the corner or on moving to the form: a click outside does not close it. If you close it with the “×”, what you wrote is still there when you open it again.

aviso-retraso.t: Delay notice: tell the customer and give a new date
aviso-retraso.why: When a delivery passes its promised date, it is better that the customer hears it from you: on one screen you state the cause, offer a new date and the email goes out.
steps: Open [[MI DÍA]], click [[Ver el resumen de hoy]] and, in the group of deliveries past their promised date, click “Notify”. “Delay notice” opens with the state of the order: promised date, last follow-up and how the supplier orders are going.
Under “WHAT CAUSED THE DELAY?” pick a cause. SOLU fills in “What happened” and “What we are doing to solve it”; you can change both texts.
Pick the “New delivery date”. If SOLU proposes one, it says where it comes from, and you take it with [[Usar esa fecha]].
Under “THEIR OTHER OPEN CASES” leave ticked the ones you want to tell the customer about in the same email.

Review the email (language, “To”, subject and text) and click [[Enviar al cliente y guardar la nueva fecha]]. If you already told them by phone or WhatsApp, use [[Ya le avisé por otro medio: solo guardar la fecha]].
aviso-retraso.expect: The new date becomes the promise to the customer, with its cause, and the order stops showing as late. The email goes out from the company mailbox and stays in the Need's history. While the cause or the date is missing, a red box says what is missing. “Propose with AI” appears once the company connects its AI key.

causas-retraso.t: Delay causes: the list offered when notifying
causas-retraso.why: So everyone explains a delay with the same causes, and each cause already carries what to tell the customer and what we propose to do.
steps: Open [[ADMINISTRACIÓN]], then [[Configuración]] and [[Causas de retraso]].
On each cause check its name, the family for Management reports, what happened (for the customer) and what we propose to do, in Spanish and in English.
To add a cause, fill in the last box, which is empty. To stop offering one, untick “Active”; to delete it, tick “Remove this cause on save”.
Click [[Guardar las causas de retraso]].
causas-retraso.expect: The new list is what people see in “Delay notice” from that moment. Management, the Commercial Director or Administration change it; everyone else sees it without being able to edit it. The text for the customer must not name or blame a supplier or carrier.

ia-llave.t: Artificial intelligence: connect and test the key
ia-llave.why: Know whether the company's AI key is connected and working, how much it has spent this month and which options it turns on.
steps: Open [[ADMINISTRACIÓN]], then [[Configuración]] and [[Inteligencia artificial]].
At the top, “AI key” reads “Connected”, “Not connected” or “Paused”. If it reads “Not connected”, follow the three steps under “HOW TO CONNECT THE KEY”, at the bottom of the page.
With the key connected, click [[Probar la conexión]]. It costs less than one US cent.
Under “WHAT THE KEY TURNS ON” check each option, where it is, how many times it was used and what it cost this month.
ia-llave.expect: If the test goes well, it reads “The test went well: the key works and the AI options are on.” If it fails, a red box says why: key not accepted, account without credit or the month's cap spent. On reaching the month's cap, AI pauses by itself until next month. The key is never typed into SOLU: it lives in Render. The test is run by Management, the Commercial Director or Administration.
